description: Functional scope: People.update_self_channel_order and confidential PeopleAuthGateway operation; expected ordered id/weight snapshot, full current-owned permutation, Person then channel row locks, dense bounded weights, atomic changesets. Tests BEFORE implementation: context rollback, foreign/duplicate/incomplete/malformed/stale membership and weights, gateway current grants/session/nil identity and confidential API envelopes. Real database/internal boundaries, no mocks. Paths: success, denial, stale, validation, rollback. Update people-access and UX/handoff contract. Existing single-weight API retained.
title: [zaq-tup] Atomic authenticated profile channel ordering
